# Faceless Champ

> Python 3.12+ programmatic video authoring (2.0.0rc1). Pillow frames by default, optional Skia
> ([docs/skia.md](docs/skia.md)) and ModernGL backends, FFmpeg MP4. Core never imports kit.

## Start here (agents)

Read [CHEATSHEET.md](CHEATSHEET.md): tested copy-paste patterns for premium scenes.
Fast path without custom code: `fc-kit shot title|stat|quote|steps|compare|end CONTENT.json
--theme neon --frame 3` (kit). Otherwise author a Scene with these building blocks:
- Theme.named("midnight"|"paper"|"ocean"|"clean-flow"|"neon"|"documentary"|"whiteboard").use()
  sets colors, fonts, type roles, radius, shadow and motion for everything created inside.
- Text(role=...), theme.fit(text, bounds, role) and fit_text(..., role=...) for all copy.
- canvas.safe_area(), Bounds.columns/rows/grid/inset/fit/point for layout; no pixel math.
- Primitives: Stat, Pill, Badge, Callout, Arc, Dot, Divider, GlassCard, IconText.
- Motion: scene.reveal(*items, stagger=, until=), scene.play_at(t, ...),
  obj.animate.through(prop, values), rate_func="emphasized"|"snappy"|"overshoot".
- End scripts with run(build); `python scene.py --preview | --frame T | --storyboard | --audit`.
- --audit / design_audit(scene) reports small text, low contrast, clutter and fixes.

- [Context-aware scene selection](facelesschamp-agent/docs/scene-selection.md)

Install from the checkout with python -m pip install -e .; use extras only as needed:
3d=PyVista/VTK (>=0.49.1,<0.50), cad=build123d+3d, geometry=Trimesh+SciPy+NetworkX+3d,
geometry-advanced=geometry+Manifold+fast-simplification, Kit coding=Pygments, web=Playwright, playground=coding+web,
equations=Matplotlib, maps=NumPy. Explicitly install Chromium for browser preparation
with python -m playwright install chromium. Default imports and prepared playback
require no browser. Do not assume a package has been published.

## Scenes, layout, and animation

Import from faceless_champ. Subclass Scene and override construct(), or build Scene(Canvas(...)).
Coordinates are design pixels, top-left origin, positive Y down; anchors default to center.
add(), play(), wait(), wait_until(), remove(), and with scene.at(time) schedule the timeline.
play arguments run concurrently; successive calls advance the cursor. Audio defaults to
the current cursor: attach master narration explicitly with add_audio(path, start=0).

Typography: use roles, not raw sizes. Text("...", role="title") with roles display,
title, heading, body, label, caption sets size/weight/line_height/tracking; explicit
args override. font names: sans (DM Sans, default), display (Space Grotesk), serif,
serif-italic (Cormorant), mono, fallback (DejaVu); paths also work. Missing glyphs
switch to DejaVu with a warning. TypeScale.named("modern"|"tech"|"editorial") picks a
pairing; pass type_scale=. fit_text(text, Bounds(...), role="body") wraps with
balanced lines, shrinks at most to 85%, and raises TextBudgetError when copy exceeds
the role budget (title 8 words/2 lines, body 22/3, label 5/1): shorten or split it.
Text preserves whitespace and never wraps. Number supports formatting and
animate.value_to(). ColorScheme.named: midnight, paper, ocean, clean-flow.
clean-flow pairs warm gray/white surfaces with black text and orange highlights.
ShadowStyle, card_surface(Bounds, fill=..., radius=44, shadow=...), card_content_bounds
and dot_grid(Bounds, color=..., spacing=28, radius=1) rasterize once as ordinary Images.
Allocated bounds include transparent shadow clearance; use card_content_bounds for content.

Create Group(*components) before adding members to a scene; membership is fixed.
Group.arrange, next_to, align_to, shift, component.bounds and Scene.bounds_at help layout.
Parent transforms/opacity apply to descendants; remove(group) ends their lifetimes.
Use Sequence for cuts/crossfades, Grid for simultaneous panels, Layer for transparent overlays.
Grid padding/start_times also affect audio. Group members retain their original coordinates.

Animations include FadeIn/Out, Draw, Write, Typewriter and Slide/Zoom/Pop/Bounce/Spin,
Pulse, Shake, Wiggle. animate supports transforms, keyframes, relative values, colors,
shape dimensions/strokes/corners, independent scale axes, and progress/value changes.
Explicit play(rate_func=...) overrides preset easing. Stagger/Succession/Repeat are
finite animation schedules; Repeat cycles counts traversals, including ping-pong reversals.
RectangleMask/CircleMask/ShapeMask and Wipe affect the complete component.
ProgressBar/ProgressRing/Gauge/LoadingDots/Checkmark use progress_to; Countdown uses value_to.
[Motion graphics](docs/motion-graphics.md).

## Compositing, shapes, shaders and math (Skia)

Needs skia-python (faceless-champ[skia]); works on backend="skia" and "pillow" (CPU),
not "moderngl". Every component takes blend= normal, multiply, screen, overlay, darken,
lighten, color_dodge, color_burn, hard_light, soft_light, difference, exclusion, hue,
saturation, color, luminosity, add, stencil, silhouette (BLEND_MODES). A Group whose
child blends is its own layer; stencil/silhouette make a child a track matte for its group.
Shapes: trim_start, draw (trim end), trim_offset, dash=(on, off, ...), dash_offset;
animate.trim_to(start=, end=, offset=), animate.dash_offset_to(px), Trace(shape, length=0.2).
PathData.from_svg(d), .rect/.ellipse/.polygon/.star, .from_text("Hi", font_size=),
booleans a | b, a & b, a - b, a ^ b, .to_svg(); show with VectorPath(path, ...).
SVG("icon.svg" or markup, width=, color=) renders vector art crisply at any size.
ShaderFill(sksl, width=, height=, uniforms=) paints a custom SkSL program (iTime,
iResolution built in). EffectStack(shader=ShaderEffect(sksl), displacement=DisplacementMap(
amplitude=12, size=120, speed=0, map=None)). Equation(expr, engine="typst") typesets Typst
math: mat(1, 2; 3, 4), cases(...), integral_0^oo, sqrt(x), a/b. MathGlyphs(expr, font_size=,
position=, outline=True) gives one VectorPath per symbol (eq.glyphs) for Draw/reveal/color.
Shapes: round_corners=r, jitter=(segment, deviation) (Skia). Any component: tilt_x, tilt_y,
perspective=1400, animate.tilt_to(x=, y=) for 2.5D (Skia/Pillow).
[Compositing guide](docs/compositing.md).

## Assets, charts, and maps

Image.from_source accepts paths, bytes, or Pillow images; trim/tint preserve alpha.
No implicit URL downloads. ImageSlot mode auto/placeholder/required reserves matching
geometry; missing auto files show a labeled box, but corrupt present files fail.
Polyline(draw_by="x") requires strictly increasing open paths; rounded caps are supported.
Equation uses the equations extra and supports symbol color_map and fixed-layout Write.
Flag(country_code) from facelesschamp_kit.maps.flags uses 254 bundled case-insensitive codes; flag_path/supported_flags
work offline. [Image and flag APIs](docs/api.md).

BarChart, RankedBarChart, LineChart, ScatterPlot, Histogram, Heatmap, NetworkGraph,
SankeyChart, VectorField, PieChart come from facelesschamp_kit.charts. RankedBarChart.animate.data_to()
interpolates ranks/values with stable category colors; None means missing data.
Axis fixes limits; ChartStyle controls fonts, line width, and titles. [Charts](docs/charts.md).
OutlineMap, SatelliteMap, EarthMap (facelesschamp_kit.maps) need maps; zoom_to/animate.rotate support geography.
[Maps](docs/maps.md).

## CodingChamp editors

Import CodingChamp, CodeTheme, CodeReveal from facelesschamp_kit.coding.
CodingChamp(code, language="python", theme="midnight", filename="main.py", ...) is a
fixed-layout editor. CodeReveal(panel, start=0, end=1) uses normalized progress.
reveal_mode: typewriter (characters), word (whitespace-separated words), block (lines).
block_ends are strictly increasing inclusive local line numbers including the final line.
Whitespace is preserved; code does not wrap, scroll implicitly, or execute.
CodeTheme.named: midnight/ocean/paper/clean-flow; customize immutable themes with dataclasses.replace.
language="text" needs no Pygments. code_cache_mb=0 disables editor sprite retention.
CodeWorkspaceDesign.named("clean-flow") saves the approved fullscreen editor/terminal
design: uniform editor scale .64, shrink .8s, restore .9s, terminal enter .6s/exit .45s,
48px margins/32px gap at 1920x1080, dark chrome, no external labels or execution.
design.window(bounds,title,children=(),fullscreen=False) returns CodeWindow (Group).
Pass chrome-free content; construct all children before Scene.add. Use code_bounds,
editor_full/editor_split/terminal_bounds; editor_motion(window,running=bool) animates
the root, editor_corners(...) supplies matching face/header animations. terminal_in/out
animate a terminal window; caller schedules visibility, typing, stdout and durations.
[API](docs/coding.md).

## Prepared coding playgrounds

Import CodeCheckpoint, PlaygroundScript, CanvasItem, ValueBinding, EventBinding,
prepare_playground, PreparedPlayground, CodeEditor, PlaygroundCanvas, PlaygroundOutput
from facelesschamp_kit.playground. Complete checkpoint revisions execute explicitly during preparation.
Animated intermediate edits never execute; outputs hold until the next publication.
Use facelesschamp_kit.playground.runtime.emit/event/inputs in authored Python programs.
ValueBinding maps emitted keys to authored items; EventBinding maps named events to
highlights, travelling signals, or tensor cells. No inferred visual meaning.
Modes: concept (cars/objects), backend (flows/variables/collections/vectors/matrices),
web (HTML/CSS/JS plus real local WebScript interactions).

asset = prepare_playground(script, cache_dir=".playground-cache", timeout=10,
                           output_limit=1_000_000, fps=15)
Saved PreparedPlayground(asset.directory) verifies and reopens without execution.
Preparation executes trusted local code with OS permissions, not a security sandbox.
Changed source/input/bindings/timing/settings require preparation; refresh=True forces it.
Incomplete/failed preparations are not published. PLAYGROUND_* errors retain context.
Keep the complete asset directory; prepare web frames at intended export FPS.
[Contracts and examples](docs/coding-playgrounds.md).

## HTML capture

Import HtmlPage, WebScript, capture_html, WebCapture, HtmlClip, WebFocus,
WebHighlight, WebCallout from facelesschamp_kit.web.
Author local HTML/assets; WebScript supports move/click/type/press/select/scroll/track.
Call capture_html explicitly, then reopen WebCapture(directory) for browser-free playback.
Track selectors before cropping/focus. Capture and export FPS should match. start_time/
end_time or sample_times prepare ranges/stills while replaying prior interactions.
HtmlClip(source_start=...) seeks on the original capture clock; final pixels hold.
Crops retain page backgrounds/occlusions. Offline captures do not record browser audio
or live external services. [HTML API](docs/html-to-video.md).

## Offline OS tutorials

Import OSClip, OSScript, MacOSPreset, File, Folder, VirtualFileSystem, SettingsPage,
Control from facelesschamp_kit.desktop. Author virtual files and semantic actions: opening,
renaming, dragging, selecting, settings/value changes. No host filesystem or desktop automation.
Desktop/finder/settings modes support isolated transparent windows; invalid hidden targets
and overlapping actions fail before export. source_start preserves script time.
[OS UI](docs/os-ui.md).

## FlowChamp

Import FlowChamp, FlowGraph, FlowNode, FlowPort, FlowEdge, FlowScript, FlowTheme,
FlowDataError from facelesschamp_kit.diagrams.
Python/JSON graph authoring supports stable IDs, ports, routes, labels, and arrows.
FlowScript authors draws, signals, reveals, highlights and element transforms and signal/highlight colors.
Recipes: workflow/system/network/idea-map/circuit in facelesschamp_kit.diagrams.examples.
FlowTheme.stroke supplies neutral outlines; None preserves legacy accent outlines.
FlowTheme.node_stroke=None inherits stroke/accent; explicit colors separate node
outlines from cables. highlight_width=2 preserves legacy emphasis width; 0 keeps it fixed.
FlowDesign.named("networking") saves the approved white rounded networking cards,
short protocol popups, blue/teal traffic, soft shadows, DM Sans and washed background.
node_card/popup/packet_marker/connections return FlowVisual Group components
with named parts and transformed face_bounds (normal bounds include shadow allocation).
backdrop returns a core Image fitted to explicit bounds.
Eight transparent icons and backdrop are bundled offline. pop_frames/move_frames,
apply_transform and transform_animation coordinate card and graph-node motion.
signal authors eased capsule traffic. connections uses persistent neutral wires,
transparent proxy node outlines and constant focus width, preserving caller script
duration/actions. complete_connections optionally authors neutral gaps or a longer horizon.
FlowScript.signal(marker="capsule") uses native glossy rounded packets; dot/packet remain.
diagnostics_at(time) samples visible bounds/labels on the original script clock;
sampling is not proof of collision-free motion. source_start supports excerpts.
Label cache defaults to 8 MiB; label_cache_mb=0 disables it. Static intervals reuse keys.
[Flow contracts](docs/flowchamp.md).

## Narration, previews, and verification

SubtitleTrack.from_srt retains original cue indices/times. overlap_tolerance defaults
strictly to 0; opt into 0.001 for known source millisecond overlaps without retiming.
Captions highlight words when explicitly desired; attach captions at source zero.
CueScene.cue_time/at_cue translates source cues to local chapter clocks; finish holds
exactly to its interval and rejects overflow. Cut-only Sequence with continuous audio
on a Layer preserves chapter source timing.

save_frame and render_storyboard sample source-time stills with output protection.
render(start_time=0, end_time=None) exports ranges preserving animation/audio offsets;
render(progress=callback) reports frames. Check frames/storyboards before a full export.
PillowRenderer has bounded held-frame/caption/code caches; zero budgets disable retention.

ArchChamp adds PyVista-backed technical 3D models, named assembly parts, deterministic camera/part/section actions, supplied fields, and world-anchored labels/dimensions. PyVista/VTK requires `faceless-champ[3d]` (or the Kit/Agent `3d` extra); the base installs only Pillow and core imports remain lazy. See [ArchChamp](docs/archchamp.md).

Public 3D imports: ArchMesh, ArchPart, ArchStyle, ArchCamera, ArchScript, ArchLabel, ArchDimension, ArchChamp, ArchDataError. ArchMesh snapshots geometry; ArchChamp.state_at/project_at/diagnostics_at support inspection. Close directly owned PillowRenderer sessions with a context manager.

## Coding tutorial template

Without custom design direction, fc-agent uses the coding-tutorial pack
(templates/coding-tutorial/style.json; helpers in facelesschamp_kit.tutorials.coding,
load_coding_tutorial(project_root)). [Template guide](templates/README.md).

Optional GPU compositing/effects: docs/moderngl.md (faceless-champ[gpu], backend=moderngl or auto). Verification: docs/moderngl-verification.md.

## Optional CAD and geometry

Build123d CAD preparation, Trimesh processing, analytic mechanisms and CAD-derived
blueprints extend ArchChamp. Install the cad, geometry or geometry-advanced extra.
See [CAD and geometry](docs/cad-geometry.md) for units, APIs and native/headless use.

## Raster source integrations and raw subtitles

Viewport(source, width=..., height=..., source_start=0) accepts RasterSource inputs.
Omit both dimensions for intrinsic size. Descriptors are deepcopy-safe inputs,
never live native contexts. open(pixel_size) returns an owned RasterSession;
frame(source_time) returns independent straight RGBA/sRGB pixels at that size.
Pure frame_key identifies equivalent pixels; fingerprint includes all source inputs.
Source age is local to component introduction, then offset/clamped to source duration.
Measurement opens no source. Sampling density stays fixed during ancestor scaling.
FunctionSource(fn, size=(w, h), duration=None, fps=None) turns fn(t, size) returning a PIL
image or numpy array into a source (also @raster_source(...) and source.viewport(...)):
the easiest bridge for matplotlib, procedural shaders or any external renderer.
Custom renderers still implement validate(node) and frame(node,time,size) only.
Component.validate_animation and Animation.resolve are the public extension hooks.
parse_srt_cues(text) returns raw ordered SubtitleCue records without rejecting
intentional overlaps. SubtitleTrack applies overlap policy. Kit exposes
read_subtitle_cues(text); Agent retains bounded inputs and source-clock diagnostics.

Kit compiles once, then CompiledVideo.frame/save_frame/storyboard/export. Kit also exports
media_probe, read_subtitle_cues, public_capabilities, validate_rendering and ExportProgress.

## Plugins

Packages extend the library through the `faceless_champ.plugins` entry-point group (or
FACELESS_CHAMP_PLUGINS="module:plugin"). A Plugin(name, themes=, easings=, components=,
sources=, shots=, capabilities=) adds Theme.named themes, rate_func easing names,
faceless_champ.plugins.component()/source() lookups, fc-kit shot templates and
fc-agent capability records. `python -m faceless_champ plugins` lists them.
[Plugin guide](docs/plugins.md).

Optional Manim Community 0.22: explicit Cairo subprocess preparation, immutable RGBA PNG playback.
Core owns PreparedFrameSource and integrations.manim; Kit owns EquationTransform, ManimCanvas and ctx.manim.
Use Project.prepare/fc-kit prepare before normal builds. Playback/discovery starts no engine; use static Equation/Write when sufficient.
Agent metadata distinguishes preparation requirements from Pillow-only playback; there is no automatic math router.
[Manim guide](docs/manim.md).
